name: Philip James de Loutherbourg
description: Franco-British painter of Swiss descent (1740–1812), born in Alsace region

summary.text: Philip James de Loutherbourg, RA was a French-born British painter who became known for his large naval works, his elaborate set designs for London theatres, and his invention of a mechanical theatre called the "Eidophusikon".
summary.title: Philip James de Loutherbourg

3259386: Lord Howe's Action, or the Glorious First of June is a 1795 painting by Philip James de Loutherbourg of the victory of British naval forces under Lord Howe over a French force led by Louis Thomas Villaret de Joyeuse on the Glorious First of June 1794.
Lord Howe's Action, or the Glorious First of June
5137846: Coalbrookdale by Night is an oil painting by Philip James de Loutherbourg, from 1801. It is held at the Science Museum, in London.
5348819: The Eidophusikon was a piece of art, no longer extant, thought up by the English actor David Garrick and created by 18th-century French painter Philip James de Loutherbourg. It opened in Leicester Square in London in February 1781.
18686037: The Battle of Alexandria is an oil on canvas history painting by the French-born British artist Philip James de Loutherbourg, from 1802. It is held at the Scottish National Gallery, in Edinburgh.
18688361: An Avalanche in the Alps is an oil on canvas landscape painting by the French-born British artist Philip James de Loutherbourg, from 1803. Painted in the emerging style of romanticism it depicts an avalanche in the mountains of the Alps.
18688362: The Battle of Camperdown is a 1799 history painting by the French-born British artist Philip James de Loutherbourg.
18688363: The Battle of the Nile is an oil on canvas history painting by the French-born British artist Philip James de Loutherbourg, from 1800.
20267949: The Destruction of Pharaoh's Army is a 1792 religious history painting by the French-born British artist Philip James de Loutherbourg. It depicts the Old Testament scene from The Exodus.
23736080: Visitor to a Moonlit Churchyard is a 1790 oil painting by the French-born British artist Philip James de Loutherbourg. It combines elements of Gothic and the emerging romantic art trend.
23754728: The Great Fire of London is an oil on canvas history painting by the French-born British artist Philip James de Loutherbourg, from 1797. It depicts the Great Fire of London in 1666 during the Restoration era.
23757509: Snowdon from Capel Curig is an oil on canvas landscape painting by the French-British artist Philip James de Loutherbourg, from 1787. It depicts Snowdon, a mountain in North Wales.
23759274: A View near Matlock, Derbyshire is an oil on canvas landscape painting by the French-born British artist Philip James de Loutherbourg, from 1785. It portrays a scene near Matlock in Derbyshire, close to the village of Matlock Bath in the Derwent Valley.
23759459: The Evening Coach, London in the Distance is an 1805 landscape painting by the French-born British-based artist Philippe-Jacques de Loutherbourg. It depicts a view of the English countryside with the River Thames and the City of London in the distance.
27966650: The Landing of British Troops at Aboukir is an oil on canvas history painting by the French-born British artist Philip James de Loutherbourg, from 1802.
The Landing of British Troops at Aboukir
28026416: Warley Camp is an oil on canvas painting by the French-born British artist Philip James de Loutherbourg, from 1780. It is often known as Warley Camp: The Review to distinguish it from its pendant painting The Mock Attack.
28030307: Banditti in a Landscape is an oil on canvas landscape painting by the French-born British artist Philip James de Loutherbourg, from 1804. It depicts a group of banditti against a stormy background with a ruined castle prominent in the distance.
28537934: A Distant Hail-Storm Coming On is a 1799 landscape painting by the French-born British artist Philip James de Loutherbourg. It is also known by the longer title A Distant Hail-Storm Coming On, and the March of Soldiers with their Baggage.
28810142: Landscape with Figures and Animals is an oil on canvas landscape painting by the French artist Philip James de Loutherbourg, from 1763. It was the first painting the young Alsatian artist publicly exhibited.
50820216: The River Wye at Tintern Abbey is an 1805 landscape painting by the French-born British artist Philip James de Loutherbourg. It depicts a view on the River Wye by Tintern Abbey in Monmouthshire.
The River Wye at Tintern Abbey
50867622: A Fishing Boat Brought Ashore near Conway Castle is an 1800 landscape painting by the French-born artist Philip James de Loutherbourg. it is a romantic view of Conwy Castle in North Wales, where a fishing vessel is being hauled ashore by its crew during a storm.
A Fishing Boat Brought Ashore near Conway Castle
50882970: The Defeat of the Spanish Armada is a 1796 history painting by the French-born British artist Philip James de Loutherbourg. A battle seascape, it depicts the defeat of the Spanish Armada at the Battle of Gravelines in 1588, thwarting Philip II's attempt to invade England.
88982359: The Falls of the Rhine at Schaffhausen is an oil on canvas landscape painting by the French-born artist Philip James de Loutherbourg, from 1788.
The Falls of the Rhine at Schaffhausen
90598812: The Shipwreck is a 1793 landscape painting by the French artist Philip James de Loutherbourg. It depicts a shipwreck on a rocky coastline during a violent storm, where the survivors are attempting to get ashore only for their lifeboat to be attacked by bandits.
90735848: The Capture of the Chevrette is an oil on canvas history painting by the French-born British artist Philip James de Loutherbourg, from 1802.
92998832: Moonlight is a 1777 nocturne by Philip James de Loutherbourg. It is now in the Musée des Beaux-Arts of Strasbourg, France.
99344535: Landscape with Animals is a 1767 painting by Philip James de Loutherbourg. It is now in the Musée des Beaux-Arts of Strasbourg, France.
107353583: Dovedale in Derbyshire is a 1784 landscape painting by Philip James de Loutherbourg. It depicts a view in the valley of Dovedale in Derbyshire.
107387326: A Cottage in Patterdale, Westmoreland is a 1783 landscape painting by the French artist Philip James de Loutherbourg. It depicts a cottage at Patterdale in the Lake District.
131561987: The Grand Attack on Valenciennes by the Combined Armies is an oil on canvas history painting by the French-born British artist Philip James de Loutherbourg, from 1794.
